Return to your seat of judgment.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Listen and judge with His wisdom

self_consequence.text:

call_barak.text:

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Summon Barak to receive the word

[TODO:ar] The Lord has chosen Barak.

barak_arrives.title: [TODO:ar] Barak Hesitates
barak_arrives.text:
[TODO:ar] "I will go only if you go."
His faith leans on your presence.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Lift him; do not crush him.

refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Faith grows when leaders walk together.
Go with him to the battle.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Lead, Do Not Wound
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Your presence is His gift to him.
Walk beside, not above.

march_to_tabor.text:
[TODO:ar] Sisera's chariots gather below.
The army watches you for a sign.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Wait for better odds and weapons
[TODO:ar] Declare the Lord goes before you

wait_consequence.text:

Lift the banner and descend.

battle_kishon.text:
[TODO:ar] Storm clouds darken the river.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Charge in the strength He gives

hold_consequence.text:

credit_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] No sword of yours broke them.
Lift His name above your own.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head in song.

ending_faithful.text:
[TODO:ar] Forty years of peace will follow.
Faith led where fear could not.
